title: A nano-crystalline Hf(IV) MOF for precise fluorometric recognition of carcinogenic nicotine and herbicide benfluralin: characterization, real-life application and mechanistic investigation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4299-4313
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00141B, Paper
Srijan Mukherjee, Sandip Roy, Pitam Chakrabarti, Vishal Trivedi, Shyam Biswas
A fluorescent Hf(IV) MOF composite was used for ultra-fast, selective and ultra-sensitive detection of nicotine (in live cells, biofluids, real water and tobacco leaves) and benfluralin herbicide.
